script.title: Autumn at the Temple of the Cloud Terrace
script.description: A Kyoto-inspired Buddhist temple: an irimoya-roofed worship hall on an exposed timber stage, a three-storey pagoda, and a hanging bronze bell. An open central doorway reveals a gilded altar; broad stairs, a wraparound veranda and a separate autumn maple complete the pilgrimage scene.
